plugins.name: studio
plugins.description: Narrated explainer lectures with visuals at the center: elicit the story, set final-quality style frames, shoot chapters in parallel and review on a local desk. Rich objects, tactile-only sound, content-sized holds, one timeline and deterministic checks. The user locks the story and says when to ship.

plugins.name: present-your-work
plugins.description: Present finished work the way a colleague would tell it: what is now true, why and the key idea, the one catch beside the answer, and what the reader decides next. Quick mode in the chat in under a minute; visual mode as a click-through page with one change per click. Exposition, not proof.

plugins.name: walk-me-through
plugins.description: Explain one mechanism as a click-through HTML page: one change per click on a stage drawn from the real data, one place to look on every click (the subject bright, the rest quiet), one short caption line, a click list approved before building, and a checker that enforces the rules. The same page plays as a video: each line types out beside its subject, then its one change, with one quiet sound per kind of change.

plugins.name: correctness
plugins.description: Find the bugs example tests cannot reach in stateful, concurrent or message-driven code: a property catalog with evidence, verified fakes, a workload with faults (Hegel, or Bombadil for UIs), input review, mutation testing and an audit of stored data. Follows Antithesis's public skills, without needing the product.
